## Scenario context

Topological Sort sequences vertices in a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) such that for every directed edge $U \to V$, vertex $U$ appears before $V$. This pattern is crucial for solving build scheduling, course prerequisites, and task compilation dependencies in $O(V + E)$ time using either Kahn's BFS algorithm or Depth-First Search.

### 1. Kahn's Algorithm (BFS)

Kahn's algorithm utilizes the concept of In-degrees —the number of incoming edges pointing to a vertex.

### 2. DFS-based Algorithm
